text:
{collection}.{field}: its person changes from {from} to {to}.
Old values stay sealed under the keys of the old person: the field would be half erasable.
Keep .personal({{ person: "{from}" }}), or add a new personal field.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: a personal field's person changes.
